stories.title: Dopo il rogo di Crans Montana i quattro ragazzi del liceo Virgilio di Milano rientrano (gradualmente) a scuola

en.title: After the Crans Montana fire, four students from Virgilio high school in Milan gradually return to school
en.summary: Four students from a Milan high school are gradually returning to school following a fire incident in Crans Montana.

stories.title: Spari da una finestra, ferita 50enne in zona Vaticano. “Non è la prima volta, punta alle donne”

en.title: Shots from a window, 50-year-old woman wounded in Vatican area. "It's not the first time, he targets women"
en.summary: A woman was hit on the arm with plastic pellets fired from a window in Vatican area. Residents report the shooter has previously targeted other women in similar incidents.

stories.title: Trump: stop ai raid sulle raffinerie, sì di Kiev e Mosca. Zelensky: Putin non rispetterà accordi

en.title: Trump: stop raids on refineries, yes from Kyiv and Moscow. Zelensky: Putin will not respect agreements
en.summary: Ukraine's leader indicated willingness to suspend attacks if Russia does the same, while expressing skepticism about Putin honoring any potential agreement on stopping refinery attacks.

stories.title: Media Iran, petroliera esplosa dopo la collisione con una mina

en.title: Iranian media: tanker exploded after collision with a mine
en.summary: Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guards announced that an oil tanker exploded following a collision with a mine.

stories.title: Spari con un’arma ad aria compressa da una finestra in centro: ferita una donna in zona Vaticano

en.title: Shots fired with air-powered weapon from window in center: woman wounded in Vatican area
en.summary: A woman was shot in the arm with an air gun in central Rome near Vatican. Authorities are searching for a suspect reportedly targeting pedestrians, in what may be part of a pattern.

stories.title: L’accusa al tycoon: “Un oligarca russo pagò le nozze alle Bahamas di Trump jr”

en.title: Accusation against tycoon: "Russian oligarch paid for Trump Jr's wedding in the Bahamas"
en.summary: A Russian oligarch allegedly spent hundreds of thousands of dollars financing the post-wedding reception for the president's son and his bride in the Bahamas last May.

stories.title: Trump annuncia la tregua degli obiettivi energetici tra Mosca e Kiev. Zelensky: “La rispettiamo”

en.title: Trump announces truce on energy targets between Moscow and Kyiv. Zelensky: "We respect it"
en.summary: Ukraine's president indicated willingness to pursue an agreement under certain conditions while expressing doubt about Russia's commitment to honoring any accord on energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Un oligarca russo paga le nozze di Donald Trump Jr

en.title: Russian oligarch pays for Donald Trump Jr's wedding
en.summary: A Russian oligarch reportedly financed an elaborate wedding celebration for the president's son held on private islands in the Bahamas.

stories.title: Crolla un albero in piazza Risorgimento a Milano: feriti tre passanti, uno è grave. «Segnalato più volte, eravamo terrorizzati»

en.title: Tree falls in Piazza Risorgimento in Milan: three pedestrians injured, one seriously. 'Reported multiple times, we were terrified'
en.summary: A tree collapsed in a Milan square, injuring three pedestrians including one seriously, with residents reporting they had previously flagged concerns about the tree.

stories.title: L’arrivo insieme e i banchi vicini: il ritorno a scuola dei ragazzi del Virgilio feriti a Crans

en.title: Together again and sitting nearby: return to school for injured Virgilio students
en.summary: Four severely burned students from the Constellation incident have returned to their classroom after months of hospitalization. The students expressed joy at reuniting with their classmates.

stories.title: Crans-Montana, i quattro ragazzi feriti tornano insieme a scuola

en.title: Crans-Montana, four injured youths return to school together
en.summary: Four young people injured in Crans-Montana have returned to school, accompanied by their parents who encouraged them to enjoy the moment.

stories.title: Trump attizza il fuoco dell’indipendenza: vertice contro Londra di Galles, Irlanda del Nord, Scozia

en.title: Trump stokes independence fire: summit against London with Wales, Northern Ireland, Scotland
en.summary: The U.S. president is pushing for separation from the United Kingdom. Leaders of Wales, Northern Ireland, and Scotland are calling for referendums and European Union membership.

stories.title: Bolognafiere, nuove partnership per crescere su moda, pet e vino

en.title: Bolognafiere, new partnerships to grow in fashion, pet and wine sectors
en.summary: Bolognafiere has formed a partnership with White Milano for international events and expanded its pet industry offerings in India and Turkey.

stories.title: IlSole24OreTV, via alla nuova stagione sul canale 63

en.title: IlSole24OreTV launches new season on channel 63
en.summary: IlSole24OreTV, the television channel of Il Sole 24 Ore Group, began its autumn programming schedule on digital terrestrial channel 63.

stories.title: Trasporti, flotte in crescita, i cinesi pronti a crescere sul mercato Ue

en.title: Transport, fleets growing, Chinese ready to expand in EU market
en.summary: A Bain & Company study of 500 transport operators found that 60% are willing to invest in new vehicles, with Italy reaching 70% and one-third considering electric vehicles.

stories.title: Nel secondo trimestre record di presenze dall’estero

en.title: Record foreign presences in second quarter
en.summary: Guest presences at accommodations increased in the second quarter while arrivals declined slightly, according to Istat data showing nearly 47 million arrivals.

stories.title: Crescono i consumi del gelato italiano e il Sigep di Rimini raddoppia i buyer

en.title: Italian gelato consumption grows and Sigep in Rimini doubles buyers
en.summary: Italian food products including gelato, bread, pizza, and coffee are expanding internationally, with these topics central to this year's Sigep trade show in Rimini.
